text: By a decree of 20 August 1618, sent to the Consulibus Cracoviensibus, King Zygmunt III Waza banned the printing and sale of Mirror of the Polish Crown, a work published in 1618 by Sebastian Miczyński, because it provoked tumults. The pamphlet had been sent to the Sejm and contributed to the anti-Jewish riots in Cracow.
